title: Chicken noodle soup

source.name: Spend With Pennies: Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup

protein: about 42g per adult portion, about 4g sugar
ingredients: 3 lb chicken breast (the leftover chicken, thawed), in 1/2 inch pieces
(1) quart bag frozen chopped carrot and celery (yours)

steps.do: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat and cook the onions until they start to soften, about 4 minutes. Meanwhile cut the chicken into 1/2 inch pieces.
Add the frozen carrot and celery and cook a few minutes until thawed. Stir in the poultry seasoning, flour, salt and pepper for a minute.
Add the broth and the chicken, bring to a boil, and simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in the noodles and simmer about 7 minutes more, until tender and the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the parsley.
For lunches, the noodles soak up broth overnight; add a splash of broth or water when reheating.

changes: Double batch with 3 lb raw chicken simmered in the broth (the original uses 2 cups cooked chicken), so an adult portion hits 40g+ protein.
Your frozen carrot and celery instead of fresh.
